Starters.name: Prawn Crackers
Starters.description: Light and airy prawn crackers — a classic Thai starter to whet the appetite.

Starters.name: Thai Fishcakes
Starters.description: Spicy authentic Thai fishcakes with herbs served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Thai Spring Rolls
Starters.description: Glass noodles, shredded cabbage, carrot and light seasonings filling in a golden crispy pastry served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Chicken Satay
Starters.description: Classic Thai marinated chicken breast on a skewer served with creamy homemade peanut sauce.

Starters.name: Beef or Pork Pieces
Starters.description: Deep fried duck with tamarind sauce, crispy fried onion and cashew nut on top.

Starters.name: Battered Sweet Corn
Starters.description: Homemade sweet corn cake using sweet corn combined in batter served with sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Prawn on Toast
Starters.description: Thick golden slices of bread with prawn marinated in crunchy sesame seeds with a side of sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Vegetables in Light Batter
Starters.description: Selected vegetables coated in golden crispy batter served with a side of sweet chilli sauce.

Starters.name: Sharing Platter for 2
Starters.description: Soft chicken satay, golden spring rolls, authentic Thai fishcakes, and crunchy prawn on toast.

Soups.name: Tom Yum Soup
Soups.description: Thailand's most famous soup with bold citrus flavours, bursting with organic Thai herbs and lemongrass. Recommended with prawns for an original taste.

Soups.name: Tom Kha Soup
Soups.description: Rich creamy Thai soup with coconut base and authentic Thai herbs. Similar to Tom Yum but creamier.

Soups.name: Soup for Sharing
Soups.description: Pick either Tom Yum or Tom Kha (large pot). Choose chicken, prawns or mixed vegetables with mushrooms.

Salads.name: Thai Style Beef Salad
Salads.description: Chewy beef tossed in tangy Thai sauce with coriander and tomatoes.

Salads.name: Thai Glass Noodle Salad
Salads.description: Light crunchy glass noodles with onions, coriander and tomatoes in Thai spicy sauce.

Salads.name: Laab
Salads.description: Light spicy meat salad with rice powder, shallots, lime, spring onions, coriander and fish sauce.

Salads.name: Papaya or Cucumber Salad
Salads.description: Sweet, acidic, salty salad with tomatoes, green beans, carrot and peanuts. May contain peanut & fish.

Wok.name: Bangkok Sweet & Sour
Wok.description: Crispy battered chicken in homemade sweet & sour sauce with onions, peppers, tomatoes and pineapple.

Wok.name: Phi Phi Cashew Nuts
Wok.description: Crispy chicken with golden cashew nuts in bold savoury sauce with onions, carrots, mushrooms and peppers.

Wok.name: Pad Kra Pow
Wok.description: Basil stir fry with fresh chilli, garlic and green beans. Add a fried egg on top for +£1.50.

Wok.name: Mixed Stir-Fried Vegetables
Wok.description: Mushrooms, onions, broccoli and carrots in oyster sauce.

Wok.name: Duck in Tamarind Sauce
Wok.description: Deep fried duck with tamarind sauce, crispy onion and cashew nuts.

Wok.name: Fresh Ginger Stir Fry
Wok.description: Ginger stir fry with garlic, onions and soy sauce.

Wok.name: Garlic & Black Pepper Stir Fry
Wok.description: Asian street-style stir fry with garlic, peppers and black beans.

Curries.name: Thai Green Curry
Curries.description: Creamy coconut milk curry with bamboo shoots, courgettes and peppers.

Curries.name: Thai Red Curry
Curries.description: Creamy and spicy curry with bamboo shoots, green beans and courgettes. Green usually hotter than red.

Curries.name: Penang Curry
Curries.description: Rich creamy curry with green beans and basil leaf.

Curries.name: Mussaman Curry
Curries.description: Mild Thai spice curry with potatoes and coconut milk. Recommended with beef.

Curries.name: Roast Duck Curry
Curries.description: Pineapple, cherry tomatoes, grapes and mixed peppers in fragrant duck curry.

Noodles & Rice.name: Pad Thai
Noodles & Rice.description: Thai rice noodles in sweet & savoury sauce with bean sprouts, carrots and peanuts.

Noodles & Rice.name: Drunken Noodles
Noodles & Rice.description: Rice noodles in chilli & garlic sauce with beans, bamboo shoots, onions, peppers and basil.

Noodles & Rice.name: Chow Mein Noodles
Noodles & Rice.description: Egg noodles stir fried in soy sauce with fresh vegetables.

Noodles & Rice.name: Pad See Ew
Noodles & Rice.description: Thick rice noodles stir fried with eggs, carrots and broccoli.

Noodles & Rice.name: Thai Fried Rice
Noodles & Rice.description: Egg fried rice with Thai soy sauce, onions, tomatoes, carrots and spring onions.

Seafood.name: Seabass Hatha
Seafood.description: Crispy deep fried seabass fillet with sweet & sour Thai sauce.

Seafood.name: Seabass in Blanket
Seafood.description: Crunchy seabass fillet glazed in homemade Thai seafood sauce.

Seafood.name: Steam Seabass with Lime Sauce
Seafood.description: Steamed seabass fillet in tangy lime Thai sauce.

Seafood.name: Seabass, Garlic & Pepper
Seafood.description: Deep fried seabass fillet with aromatic garlic and black pepper.

Sides.name: Coconut Rice
Sides.description: Jasmine rice cooked in rich coconut milk.

Sides.name: Egg Noodles Stir Fry
Sides.description: Wok-tossed egg noodles with fresh vegetables.

Desserts.name: Mango with Sticky Rice
Desserts.description: Thailand's most adored dessert — sweet glutinous rice in warm coconut cream, paired with perfectly ripe mango.

Drinks.name: Soft Drinks
Drinks.description: Coke, Diet Coke, Lemonade, J20, Mineral Water, Sparkling Mineral Water, Tonic Water or Soda Water.

Drinks.name: Thai Tea with Milk
Drinks.description: Creamy, sweet authentic Thai tea brewed with rich orange pekoe tea leaves and milk.

Drinks.name: Thai Green Tea with Milk
Drinks.description: Refreshing Thai green tea served with creamy milk.

Drinks.name: Lemon Tea
Drinks.description: Bright and zesty lemon-infused Thai tea.
